structure: Lowest raw one-minute low from the original five-minute touch candle through the confirmation candle, before entry.
execution: Stop fill is the worse of the structural level and the hit minute's open, followed by unchanged modeled exit slippage and fees.
constraints: reject a Dip candidate when its structural stop is wider than 4.5%
use a 1.5% minimum distance when structure is closer
order size is min(4.5 dollars / stop fraction, 130 dollars)
available wallet cash is a hard limit
notes: All three buffers are frozen and tested separately. August-September 2026 is diagnostic only and excluded from acceptance.
